items.title: VinFast VF8 2027 launched in PH: Prices, Specs, Features
items.summary:
This compact crossover, like the rest of the Vietnamese carmaker’s lineup, is a fully electric vehicle. It stands 4,701mm long, 1,872mm wide, and 1,670mm tall and has 170mm of ground clearance. It’s got a sleek front fascia matched with a stylish rear end. In the non-black variants, the grille and a portion of the tailgate remain blacked-out, which make for a somewhat two-tone look.

photo of the vinfast vf8 2027 [...] The all-new VinFast VF8 is now available in the Philippines for P1.548 million with the brand’s EV battery subscription program. If you want to opt out of the subscription, the SRP goes up to P1.799 million. Color options for the all-new VF8 are namely: Infinity Blanc, Starburst Blue, Jet Black, and the two-tone blacktop Solar Ruby that costs an additional P10,000.

What do you think of the all-new VF8, readers? The comments section is open.

## More photos of the all-new VinFast VF8 2027: [...] The VF8 has a five-seat configuration, and its cabin is stitched in a healthy amount of leather and soft-touch materials. There’s a large center screen on the dash, a wireless charger and cup holders on the center console, and a sizeable storage compartment underneath. With a 2,840mm wheelbase, there’s plenty of legroom for all five passengers.

After opening the order books and being recognized by the Department of Energy (DOE) as an electric vehicle (EV), VinFast Philippines has officially launched the VF 8. Serving as their latest D-segment EV offering, the second-generation VF 8 features the brand's newest design language and is actually smaller than the first-generation model it will be replacing. With it, users can activate it by saying “Hey ViVi” or pressing the voice button on the steering wheel. They can then ask ViVi to adjust the fan speed of the climate control, open or close the windows remotely, open or close the power tailgate, and even turn on or turn off the interior lights in the VF 8.
